text:
ANTIFRAUD::enable
Description
Enables the ANTIFRAUD plugin.
Note: requires a separate license for use.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
enable
ANTIFRAUD
::
enable
<
profile
>
ANTIFRAUD::enable
Applies the default anti-fraud profile attached to the virtual
server.
ANTIFRAUD::enable <profile>
Applies the specified anti-fraud profile to the flow instead of the
default profile attached to the virtual server.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
# apply default anti-fraud profile on the transaction with Antifraud-Foo HTTP header
if
[
HTTP
::
header
exists
"Antifraud-Foo"
]
{
ANTIFRAUD
::
enable
}
# apply /Common/antifraud_bar profile on the transaction with Antifraud-Bar HTTP header
if
[
HTTP
::
header
exists
"Antifraud-Bar"
]
{
ANTIFRAUD
::
enable
/
Common
/
antifraud_bar
}
}
